title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks

paragraphs.en: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3 , building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation , reflection , rule revision , compilation , and verification , the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0 100.0 , and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins : 0 21\!:\!0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement aims to enable autonomous agents to acquire knowledge from experience and progressively improve their capabilities. An agent entering an unfamiliar environment must learn not only which actions are useful, but also what its actions do. It may initially know neither the environment’s objects and dynamics nor the criterion for success. A model-based agent learns a world model to predict the consequences of actions before executing them [ 38 , 14 , 6 , 35 ] . Programs are attractive representations for such models, encoding state transitions and goal conditions as executable functions that a planner can query repeatedly. They support fast, inspectable simulation, while discrepancies between predicted and observed transitions provide concrete counterexamples to the current model. Recent code world models demonstrate the promise of learning such programs from interaction [ 39 , 8 , 30 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进旨在使自主智能体能够从经验中获取知识，并逐步提升其能力。 进入陌生环境的智能体不仅要学习哪些行动是有益的，还要理解这些行动会产生什么效果。 最初，它可能既不了解环境中的对象和动态机制，也不知道成功的评价标准。 基于模型的智能体通过学习世界模型来预测行动的后果，然后再执行这些行动 [ 38 , 14 , 6 , 35 ] 。 程序是这类模型的理想表示形式，它将状态转换和目标条件编码为规划器可以反复查询的可执行函数。 它们支持快速且可检查的模拟，而预测转换与实际观察到的转换之间的差异则为当前模型提供了具体的反例。 近期的代码世界模型表明，通过交互学习此类程序具有广阔前景 [ 39 , 8 , 30 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Agreement with observed transitions, however, does not guarantee correct generalisation. A finite interaction history typically leaves a version space of programs that reproduce every observed transition but disagree on unobserved states [ 24 ] . When planning queries such states, the selected program must make predictions that the available evidence does not determine. For example, if every observed wall lies at column 7, the hypotheses “a box stops at a wall” and “a box stops at column 7” may explain the same trajectory while predicting different outcomes when a wall appears elsewhere. Replay can reject an inconsistent program, but cannot identify the correct rule among consistent alternatives. The agent therefore needs to maintain and revise its generalisation hypotheses as new evidence arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，与观测到的状态转换相符，并不保证能够正确泛化。 有限的交互历史通常会留下一个程序版本空间，这些程序可以重现所有观测到的状态转换，但在未观测到的状态上却存在分歧 [ 24 ] 。 在规划查询此类状态时，所选程序必须做出可用证据无法确定的预测。 例如，如果所有观测到的墙壁都位于第 7 列，那么“箱子在遇到墙壁时停止”和“箱子在第 7 列停止”这两个假设可能解释相同的轨迹，但当墙壁出现在其他位置时，它们会预测不同的结果。 重播可以拒绝不一致的程序，但无法在一致的可替代方案中识别出正确的规则。 因此，智能体需要随着新证据的出现而维持并修正其泛化假设。

paragraphs.en: Our Memento series [ 48 , 42 , 49 ] provides a complementary perspective on this problem by treating external memory, rather than model parameters, as the agent’s evolving learning state. Memento introduced continual adaptation through episodic memory, in which interaction outcomes are written into memory and retrieved to improve later decisions [ 48 ] . Memento 2 formalised this process as stateful reflective learning, interpreting memory writing as policy evaluation and memory reading as policy improvement [ 42 ] . Memento-Skills then extended the learning state from individual experiences to reusable procedural memory, allowing agents to construct and refine executable skills without updating the underlying LLM [ 49 ] . These works primarily improve the policy side of an agent by learning which decisions or procedures should be used. An unfamiliar interactive environment introduces the complementary problem of learning the model side: the rules that determine how the world behaves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 Memento 系列 [ 48 , 42 , 49 ] 将外部记忆而非模型参数视为智能体不断演化的学习状态，从而为这一问题提供了补充性的视角。 Memento 通过情景记忆引入了持续适应机制：交互结果会被写入记忆，并在后续决策中调取以优化判断 [ 48 ] 。 Memento 2 将这一过程正式化为“带状态的反省式学习”，即将记忆写入解释为策略评估，而记忆读取则解释为策略改进 [ 42 ] 。 随后，Memento-Skills 将学习状态从个体经验扩展至可重复使用的前进性记忆，使智能体无需更新底层 LLM 即可构建并完善可执行技能 [ 49 ] 。 这些研究主要通过学习应使用哪些决策或程序，来改进智能体的策略部分。 一个陌生的交互环境则引出了另一个互补性问题：学习模型部分，即决定世界运行方式的规则。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Memento 3 as the model-based continuation of the Memento series. Memento 3 extends reflective learning from policy and procedural memory to explicit world models. Its central design, which we call Code as Model, represents the agent’s evolving understanding of the environment through a natural-language rulebook and an executable realisation. The interaction history provides episodic evidence, while a natural-language rulebook serves as semantic memory, recording the agent’s current hypotheses about objects, actions, dynamics, and goals. The rulebook makes these hypotheses explicit so that later observations can be used to assess and revise them. Code is generated from the rulebook as its executable realisation for prediction and planning, as illustrated in Figure 1 . The two representations serve complementary roles: the rulebook states the environment rules the agent believes, while execution fixes how those rules are applied. Together they form a persistent world-model hypothesis that can be inspected, tested, and revised throughout interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Memento 3 介绍为 Memento 系列的基于模型的后继版本。 Memento 3 将反思性学习从策略和程序性记忆扩展到了显式的世界模型。 其核心设计被称为“代码即模型”，通过自然语言规则书和可执行的实现，展现了智能体对环境理解的持续演变。 交互历史提供了情境性证据，而自然语言规则书则充当语义记忆，记录智能体对物体、动作、动态和目标的当前假设。 规则书将这些假设显性化，以便后续观察可用于评估和修正它们。 代码从规则书中生成，作为其用于预测和规划的可执行实现，如图 1 所示。 这两种表示形式发挥着互补作用：规则书陈述了智能体所相信的环境规则，而执行则确定了这些规则的具体应用方式。 二者共同构成了一个持久性的世界模型假设，该假设可以在整个交互过程中被检查、测试和修正。

paragraphs.en: This design lets us investigate a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI) . RSI describes an AI system autonomously designing and developing its own successor, with subsequent versions continuing this process [ 12 ] . Its recursive mechanism is a feedback loop in which the system uses its current capabilities to improve the components supporting its reasoning, planning, and learning [ 45 ] . In Code as Model, the persistent rulebook and its executable realisation are both objects of revision and tools for further learning. They guide subsequent planning and exploration, shaping the evidence the agent obtains for its next round of model revision. Their rules and predictions also provide a basis for diagnosing prediction errors. Through the reflective learning loop in Figure 2 , the agent adopts verified updates to these components while the underlying LLM remains fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计使我们能够探索一种基于模型的方法，以实现递归自我改进（RSI）。 RSI 指的是一个人工智能系统能够自主设计和开发自己的后续版本，而后续版本则会继续这一过程 [ 12 ]。 其递归机制是一个反馈循环：系统利用当前的能力来改进支撑其推理、规划和学习的组件 [ 45 ]。 在《代码即模型》中，持久的规则手册及其可执行实现既是修订的对象，也是进一步学习的工具。 它们指导后续的规划和探索，并塑造智能体为下一轮模型修订所获得的证据。 它们的规则和预测也为诊断预测错误提供了基础。 通过图 2 中的反思性学习循环，智能体会采用经过验证的更新来改进这些组件，而底层的 LLM 则保持不变。

sents.en: In Code as Model, the persistent rulebook and its executable realisation are both objects of revision and tools for further learning.

sents.en: They guide subsequent planning and exploration, shaping the evidence the agent obtains for its next round of model revision.

sents.en: Through the reflective learning loop in Figure 2 , the agent adopts verified updates to these components while the underlying LLM remains fixed.

paragraphs.en: Exact replay can leave several world-model hypotheses consistent with the same evidence. The LLM favours concise rulebooks and implementations, subject to rulebook fidelity and exact replay, as a practical minimum-description-length bias [ 28 ] . This preference does not eliminate uncertainty, and committing to one hypothesis may steer exploration away from evidence that would falsify it. We therefore extend the single-model setting to N N world models maintained in parallel, each represented by a rulebook–executable pair and sharing the same interaction history. One member is sampled for each planning episode, and the resulting transitions are used to check all members. Different models can thus guide exploration while remaining consistent with shared evidence; N = 1 N=1 recovers the single-model setting.
paragraphs.zh: 精确重播可能使多个世界模型假设与相同的证据保持一致。 LLM倾向于简洁的规则手册和实现，但需遵循规则手册的保真度和精确重播原则，这是出于实际最小描述长度偏好的考虑 [ 28 ] 。 这种偏好并未消除不确定性，而执着于某一假设可能会使探索偏离能够证伪该假设的证据。 因此，我们将单模型设定扩展为并行维护的 N 个世界模型，每个模型由一个规则手册–可执行文件对表示，并共享相同的交互历史。 每次规划回合都会采样其中一个模型，并利用由此产生的状态转移来验证所有模型。 这样，不同的模型可以在保持与共享证据一致的同时引导探索；当 N = 1 时，即可恢复单模型设定。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Code as Model on ARC-AGI-3 [ 1 ] , where agents must infer unfamiliar game rules and goals under a human-derived action budget. The single-model agent clears every level of all 25 25 public games, reaches the Relative Human Action Efficiency ceiling with a mean RHAE of 100.0 100.0 , and uses 44% of the corresponding human action count. Compared with Claude Opus 5 with the ARC Prize Standard harness [ 2 ] , our agent achieves a 59.3 59.3 -point higher mean RHAE. We also examine whether the learning mechanism can support feedback control in addition to discrete planning. In Atari Pong, the learned model supports a controller that wins : 0 21\!:\!0 in three evaluated episodes with different openings, acting without further LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ARC-AGI-3 [ 1 ] 上对 Code as Model 进行了评估，其中智能体必须在人类设定的行动预算下推断不熟悉的游戏规则和目标。 该单模型智能体通关了全部 25 款公开游戏中的每一关，达到了相对人类行动效率（RHAE）的上限，平均 RHAE 为 100.0，并使用了相应人类行动次数的 44%。 与使用 ARC Prize Standard harness [ 2 ] 的 Claude Opus 5 相比，我们的智能体实现了高出 59.3 点的平均 RHAE。 我们还研究了该学习机制除了离散规划之外，是否还能支持反馈控制。 在 Atari Pong 游戏中，所学到的模型支持一个控制器，在三个经过评估的不同开局回合中取得了 : 0 21\!:\!0 的战绩，且无需再次调用 LLM。

paragraphs.en: Learning a world model from interaction involves forming and revising hypotheses about an unfamiliar environment’s rules as new evidence arrives. In Code as Model, the agent records its current hypotheses in a natural-language rulebook and implements them in executable code for prediction and planning. Figure 2 summarises this continual learning loop: new observations drive revisions to the rulebook and executable, and the revised model guides subsequent interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 通过互动学习世界模型，意味着在获取新证据时，不断构建和修正对陌生环境规则的假设。 在《代码即模型》中，智能体将其当前的假设记录在自然语言规则手册中，并通过可执行代码实现这些假设，以进行预测和规划。 图 2 总结了这一持续学习循环：新的观察结果会推动规则手册和可执行代码的更新，而更新后的模型则会指导后续的互动。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a model-based approach that learns an environment model from interaction and uses its predictions to select actions. In Code as Model, a frozen LLM proposes transition rules and goal conditions in a natural-language rulebook and compiles them into executable code. A planner queries the verified executable to search for action sequences predicted to reach a goal within the remaining budget. The agent follows the resulting plan, using discrepancies between predicted and observed outcomes to guide revisions to the rulebook and code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用一种基于模型的方法，该方法通过交互学习环境模型，并利用其预测来选择动作。 在《代码即模型》中，一个冻结的 LLM 会在自然语言规则书中提出转换规则和目标条件，并将其编译为可执行代码。 规划器会查询经过验证的可执行代码，以搜索预测能够利用剩余预算达成目标的动作序列。 智能体遵循由此产生的计划，并利用预测结果与观察结果之间的差异来指导对规则书和代码的修订。

paragraphs.en: Code as Model stores the agent’s model history in a Git repository. The rulebook and the modules compiled from it live as files in a single version-controlled workspace. After each iteration, the controller commits the workspace and tags the commit with the iteration number. Without version control, each revision destructively overwrites the rulebook or implementation it replaces. Here, every ψ \psi and every θ \theta the run has held remains addressable, together with when it was written. The repository therefore records the agent’s learning trajectory, not just a snapshot of its latest state.
paragraphs.zh: Code as Model 将智能体的模型历史存储在一个 Git 仓库中。 规则书以及由此编译出的模块以文件形式存在于一个受版本控制的单一工作区中。 每次迭代结束后，控制器都会提交该工作区，并用迭代编号为此次提交打上标签。 如果没有版本控制，每个修订版本都会破坏性地覆盖其所替代的规则书或实现。 在这里，运行过程中保留下来的每一个 ψ \psi 和 θ \theta 都可以被追溯，连同其写入的时间一同保留。 因此，该仓库记录的是智能体的学习轨迹，而不仅仅是其最新状态的快照。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, this history is available to the agent itself. It can inspect earlier iterations, diff two versions of the rulebook or of a module, and recover their contents at any previous commit. The agent can therefore recall hypotheses it has already tested, examine the consequences of a past revision, or restore an executable that a later edit broke.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of the natural-language rulebook, we remove it from the update loop. This leaves a code world model while keeping the harness, the replay verifier, the plan executor, the backbone and the reasoning effort byte-identical. paragraphs.en: In ARC-AGI-3, the agent interacts with an unknown deterministic environment, where each level presents a discrete goal and performance is measured by action efficiency. The executable world model supports a planner that searches for a finite action sequence to complete the current level. This raises a broader question: can the same rulebook-based learning mechanism also support feedback control, where the agent repeatedly updates its decisions from new observations? We investigate this question in Atari Pong [ 3 ] , a two-player adversarial setting in which the agent must model both the physical dynamics and the opponent’s behaviour. The agent controls one paddle and must anticipate how the ball and the opposing paddle will move.

paragraphs.en: We compare our method with three types of baselines: a direct LLM agent with chain-of-thought reasoning, model-free reinforcement learning (RL) methods, and model-based RL methods ( Table 5 ).

paragraphs.en: Among the model-free RL baselines, GDI [ 10 ] optimises both policy learning and the distribution of training data. LASER [ 34 ] is an off-policy actor–critic method with shared experience replay, while IMPALA [ 9 ] uses distributed actor–critic learning with V-trace correction. paragraphs.en: Language-guided program induction provides a foundation for constructing such models. Parsel combines natural-language decompositions with execution-based testing [ 47 ] , and Hypothesis Search translates language hypotheses into programs verified on input-output examples [ 43 ] . For interactive environments, WorldCoder learns Python dynamics models and repairs them against observed counterexamples [ 39 ] ; GIF-MCTS searches over candidate models through generation, improvement, and repair guided by descriptions, tests, and trajectories [ 8 ] . Code World Models for General Game Playing constructs transition, legality, and termination functions from rules and trajectories to support Monte Carlo tree search [ 21 ] . Code-as-World extends executable modelling to physical reasoning through a loop of program proposal, execution, rendering, and verification [ 41 ] . Together, these works establish language-guided construction and execution-based refinement as useful mechanisms for learning explicit models.
paragraphs.zh: 语言引导的程序归纳为构建此类模型提供了基础。 Parsel 将自然语言分解与基于执行的测试相结合 [47]，而 Hypothesis Search 则将语言假设转化为通过输入输出示例验证的程序 [43]。 对于交互式环境，WorldCoder 学习 Python 动态模型，并通过观察到的反例对其进行修复 [39]；GIF-MCTS 则通过由描述、测试和轨迹引导的生成、改进和修复过程，在候选模型中进行搜索 [8]。 Code World Models for General Game Playing 从规则和轨迹中构建转换、合法性和终止函数，以支持蒙特卡洛树搜索 [21]。 Code-as-World 通过程序提议、执行、渲染和验证的循环，将可执行建模扩展到物理推理领域 [41]。 这些工作共同确立了语言引导的构建和基于执行的精化为学习显式模型的有效机制。

paragraphs.en: Several ARC-AGI-3 systems closely connect model construction, verification, and action selection. Rodionov’s baseline1 maintains, simplifies, and verifies a persistent Python model before planning through it [ 30 ] . Its subsequent component study finds exact verification consistently useful within the tested configurations, but does not find that requiring an executable model uniformly improves action performance [ 29 ] . OPINE-World maintains natural-language hypotheses, synthesises an object-centric executable, and uses ontology error to direct exploration; candidate programs must reproduce recorded transitions exactly [ 7 ] . Twin similarly gates model-based action on replay of the interaction history [ 37 ] . Tycho examines when an agent should construct, repair, use, or bypass an executable model, showing that better transition replay need not yield better decisions when objectives are misidentified or models are used inappropriately [ 20 ] . These results motivate examining how a learned model is maintained and used, alongside its predictive accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 多个 ARC-AGI-3 系统将模型构建、验证和行动选择紧密结合起来。 Rodionov 的基线方法1在通过该模型进行规划之前，会维护、简化并验证一个持久的 Python 模型 [ 30 ] 。 其后续的分组件研究发现，在测试的配置中，精确验证始终有用，但并未发现要求使用可执行模型能统一提升行动表现 [ 29 ] 。 OPINE-World 维护自然语言假设，合成以对象为中心的可执行模型，并利用本体论错误来指导探索；候选程序必须完全重现已记录的转换过程 [ 7 ] 。 Twin 同样基于交互历史的重播来启用模型驱动的行动 [ 37 ] 。 Tycho 研究了智能体何时应构建、修复、使用或绕过可执行模型，结果表明，当目标识别错误或模型使用不当时，更优的转换重播并不一定能带来更好的决策 [ 20 ] 。 这些结果促使我们研究，除了预测准确性之外，还应如何考察已学习模型的维护与使用方式。

paragraphs.en: Textual memory offers another way for frozen LLM agents to learn from interaction. Reflexion stores linguistic reflections on task feedback to improve later decisions [ 36 ] . AutoManual induces and organises environment rules into reusable manuals [ 4 ] . WALL-E updates and prunes symbolic rules by comparing predicted and observed trajectories, using those rules to align an LLM world model with its environment [ 50 ] . These approaches range from retaining advice about past decisions to maintaining explicit descriptions of environment behaviour, establishing language as an editable medium for both experience and rule knowledge.

paragraphs.en: The Memento series develops reflective memory from episodic adaptation [ 48 ] to stateful reflective learning, which links memory writing and reading to policy evaluation and improvement [ 42 ] , and then to reusable executable skills [ 49 ] . Code as Model extends this progression to model-side semantic memory: a persistent rulebook and its executable realisation jointly represent a world-model hypothesis. Reflection can revise an environment rule or repair its implementation while retaining the rule. The LLM assesses code–rulebook fidelity, and replay checks the executable against recorded transitions. Language rules, executable artefacts, reflection, and replay are established components; we organise them around a persistent environment specification supporting both semantic revision and implementation repair.

paragraphs.en: Version spaces formalise the ambiguity left by finite evidence [ 24 , 25 ] , and minimum description length provides a simplicity preference among consistent hypotheses [ 28 ] . Model-based reinforcement learning represents uncertainty through probabilistic dynamics models or ensembles [ 19 , 6 ] . Posterior sampling and related methods retain a sampled hypothesis or value function across an episode to support temporally coherent exploration [ 27 , 26 , 23 ] . Our population extension applies this principle by maintaining multiple world models in parallel. Each member pairs a rulebook with an executable, and all members are checked against shared interaction evidence. Sampling a member for planning allows different models to guide exploration. The population is a computational approximation to the remaining version space, rather than a calibrated Bayesian posterior; its purpose is to reduce dependence on a single early model construction.
paragraphs.zh: 版本空间将有限证据所留下的模糊性形式化 [24, 25]，而最小描述长度则在一致假设中偏好更简单的假设 [28]。 基于模型的政策强化学习通过概率动态模型或模型集来表示不确定性 [19, 6]。 后验采样及相关方法在整个回合中保留一个采样出的假设或价值函数，以支持时间上连贯的探索 [27, 26, 23]。 我们的种群扩展通过并行维护多个世界模型来应用这一原则。 每个成员都将一本规则书与一个可执行程序配对，并且所有成员都会根据共享的交互证据进行检验。 为规划而采样一个成员，可以让不同的模型引导探索过程。 该种群是对剩余版本空间的一种计算近似，而非经过校准的贝叶斯后验分布；其目的是减少对单一早期模型构建的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Broader approaches to agent adaptation treat external software and workspaces as editable learning state. Workspace Optimization instantiates this view in DreamTeam, whose specialised agents build models, probe hypotheses, and plan [ 33 ] . Continual Harness supports reset-free revision of prompts, subagents, skills, and memory [ 17 ] . NOOA combines a Python object-oriented agent interface with persistent executable modules, prediction-error-driven refinement, and cross-level memory in ARC-AGI-3 [ 13 ] . Belief-Calibrated Optimization maintains a language world model of how evaluation responds to changes in an agent’s prompt and scaffolding [ 5 ] . Its model guides edits to the agent, whereas Code as Model predicts transitions within the environment to support planning and control. These models support complementary forms of agent improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的智能体适应方法将外部软件和工作空间视为可编辑的学习状态。 工作空间优化在 DreamTeam 中具体化了这一观点，其专用智能体能够构建模型、检验假设并制定计划 [ 33 ] 。 Continual Harness 支持无需重置地修订提示词、子智能体、技能和记忆 [ 17 ] 。 NOOA 将 Python 面向对象智能体接口与持久化的可执行模块、基于预测误差的优化以及 ARC-AGI-3 中的跨层级记忆相结合 [ 13 ] 。 信念校准优化维护一个语言世界模型，用于描述评估如何对智能体提示词和支撑结构的变更作出响应 [ 5 ] 。 该模型指导对智能体的修改，而“代码即模型”则预测环境内的状态转换，以支持规划与控制。 这些模型支持相互补充的智能体改进方式。

paragraphs.en: ARC-AGI-3 provides a shared setting for studying these approaches under unfamiliar rules and a human-derived action budget [ 1 ] . It also supports alternatives such as graph-based exploration, which records observed transitions and prioritises untested actions without a generative world model [ 32 ] . Tycho and Rodionov’s component study report saturation or near-saturation of the public set with stronger frontier models [ 20 , 29 ] . Public-set completion alone therefore cannot isolate the contribution of a world-model architecture. Comparisons must also account for model choice and reasoning budget, and examine action efficiency, repeated-run stability, and held-out evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: ARC-AGI-3 提供了一个共享环境，用于在陌生规则和人类设定的行动预算下研究这些方法 [ 1 ] 。 它还支持其他替代方案，例如基于图的探索方法，该方法会记录观察到的状态转换，并在没有生成式世界模型的情况下优先选择未经测试的行动 [ 32 ] 。 Tycho 和 Rodionov 的组件研究指出，使用更强大的前沿模型时，公共数据集已出现饱和或接近饱和的现象 [ 20 , 29 ] 。 因此，仅通过完成公共数据集无法孤立地确定世界模型架构所做出的贡献。 比较时还必须考虑模型选择和推理预算，并检验行动效率、重复运行稳定性以及预留测试集的表现。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Memento 3 , which extends reflective learning to explicit world models through Code as Model. The agent records environment hypotheses in a natural-language rulebook, compiles them into code for prediction and planning, and revises both through interaction while keeping the underlying LLM fixed. The population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, each updated and verified against a shared interaction history. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 25 public games and reaches the RHAE ceiling, using 7,518 actions, or 44% of the human action count. In Atari Pong, the learned model supports a feedback controller that wins : 0 21\!:\!0 in three evaluated episodes with different openings, without LLM calls during execution. By carrying verified model updates into subsequent planning and exploration, the agent uses what it has learned to shape the evidence for further revisions. This feedback is the model-based route to recursive self-improvement investigated in this work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Memento 3，它通过“代码即模型”的方法，将反思式学习扩展到了显式的世界模型中。 该智能体以自然语言规则手册的形式记录环境假设，将其编译为代码用于预测和规划，并通过交互对两者进行修订，同时保持底层 LLM 不变。 种群扩展机制并行维护多个世界模型，每个模型都基于共享的交互历史进行更新和验证。 在 ARC-AGI-3 测试中，单模型智能体完成了全部 25 款公开游戏中的每一关，并达到了 RHAE 上限，共使用 7,518 次动作，占人类动作数的 44%。 在 Atari Pong 游戏中，学习到的模型支持一个反馈控制器，在三个经过评估的不同开局回合中均以 : 0 21\!:\!0 的比分获胜，且执行过程中未调用 LLM。 通过将已验证的模型更新带入后续的规划和探索中，该智能体利用所学知识来塑造进一步修订所需的证据。 这种反馈机制正是本研究所探讨的、基于模型的递归自我改进路径。
